title: От Луки 6 — Luke 6
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Тот протянул, и его ___ стала совершенно здоровой.
cases.translation: He stretched it out, and his hand became completely healthy.
cases.explain: Рука is the subject of стала (became) — the thing that became healthy — so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Он взял священный хлеб, который нельзя есть никому, кроме ___.
cases.translation: He took the sacred bread, which no one may eat except the priests.
cases.explain: The preposition кроме (except) always governs the genitive; here it is the genitive plural, священников.

cases.sentence: Так что каждое дерево узнают по его ___.
cases.translation: So every tree is recognized by its fruit.
cases.explain: По in the sense “by / according to” governs the dative; плодам is the dative plural of плод.

cases.sentence: Тому, кто оскорбит тебя, ударив по ___, подставь и другую.
cases.translation: To the one who insults you by striking you on the cheek, offer the other also.
cases.explain: По meaning “on / against” a body part governs the dative, so щека becomes щеке.

cases.translation: Jesus went up onto the mountain to pray.
cases.explain: На expressing motion onto something governs the accusative, so гора becomes гору.

cases.sentence: Они стали обсуждать между собой, что бы им сделать с ___.
cases.translation: They began discussing among themselves what they might do with Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental, giving Иисусом.

cases.sentence: Иисус провел всю ночь в ___ Богу.
cases.translation: Jesus spent the whole night in prayer to God.
cases.explain: В marking a state (being in prayer) governs the prepositional case, so молитва becomes молитве.

cases.sentence: Из хранилища ___ в своем сердце добрый человек выносит доброе.
cases.translation: Out of the treasury of good in his heart, the good man brings out good things.
cases.explain: Из (out of) governs the genitive, so добро becomes добра.

reading.ru: Однажды в субботу, когда Иисус проходил через засеянные поля, Его ученики срывали колосья, растирали их руками и ели зерна.
reading.question: What were Jesus's disciples doing as they walked through the grain fields on the Sabbath?
options: Picking heads of grain and eating them
reading.correct: Picking heads of grain and eating them
reading.explain: The disciples plucked heads of grain, rubbed them in their hands, and ate the kernels as they passed through the fields.

reading.ru: Но некоторые фарисеи спросили, «Почему вы делаете то, что не разрешается делать в субботу?»
reading.question: What did the Pharisees accuse the disciples of doing?
reading.explain: The Pharisees asked why the disciples were doing what was not lawful to do on the Sabbath.

reading.ru: Он вошел в Дом Божий, взял священный хлеб, который нельзя есть никому, кроме священников, и ел, а также дал его своим людям, и добавил, «Сын человеческий, Господин над субботой».
reading.question: In defending his disciples, what example from David's life did Jesus give?
options: David ate the consecrated bread reserved for priests
David wrote psalms on the Sabbath
reading.correct: David ate the consecrated bread reserved for priests
reading.explain: Jesus recalled how David entered the house of God, ate the sacred bread lawful only for priests, and gave some to his companions.

reading.ru: Учители закона и фарисеи внимательно наблюдали за ним, не будет ли он исцелять в субботу, потому что искали повод обвинить его.
reading.question: Why were the teachers of the law and the Pharisees watching Jesus in the synagogue?
options: To find a reason to accuse him
To protect the man with the withered hand
reading.correct: To find a reason to accuse him
reading.explain: They watched closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath, because they were looking for a reason to accuse him.

reading.ru: Тот протянул, и его рука стала совершенно здоровой, а они пришли в ярость и стали обсуждать между собой, что бы им сделать с Иисусом.
reading.question: How did the Pharisees react after Jesus healed the man's hand?
options: They became furious and plotted against Jesus
They asked to be healed too
They left the synagogue in silence
reading.correct: They became furious and plotted against Jesus
reading.explain: After the man's hand was completely restored, they were filled with rage and discussed what to do about Jesus.

reading.ru: Когда наступил день, Он позвал своих учеников и выбрал из них двенадцать, которых и назвал апостолами.
reading.question: What did Jesus do after spending the night in prayer on the mountain?
options: He chose twelve of his disciples and named them apostles
He fed a crowd of five thousand
reading.correct: He chose twelve of his disciples and named them apostles
reading.explain: When day came, Jesus called his disciples and chose twelve of them, whom he named apostles.

reading.ru: Иисус спустился с ними вниз на равнину, там уже собралась большая толпа его учеников и великое множество народа со всей Иудеи, Иерусалима и прибрежных областей Тира и Сидона.
reading.question: Where did the great crowd that gathered to hear Jesus come from?
options: All Judea, Jerusalem, and the coast of Tyre and Sidon
reading.correct: All Judea, Jerusalem, and the coast of Tyre and Sidon
reading.explain: The crowd on the plain included people from all Judea, Jerusalem, and the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon.

reading.ru: «Блаженны вы, бедные, потому что вам принадлежит Божье Царство».
reading.question: According to the beatitudes, who does the Kingdom of God belong to?
reading.explain: Jesus said, “Blessed are you who are poor, for the Kingdom of God is yours.”

reading.ru: Но горе вам богаты, потому что вы уже получили свое утешение.
reading.question: What warning does Jesus give to the rich?
options: They have already received their comfort
They must give away all they own immediately
reading.correct: They have already received their comfort
reading.explain: Jesus pronounces woe on the rich because they have already received their comfort.

reading.ru: Любите ваших врагов, делайте добро тем, кто ненавидит вас, благословляйте тех, кто проклинает вас, и молитесь о тех, кто оскорбляет вас.
reading.question: What does Jesus command his listeners to do toward their enemies?
options: Love them, do good to them, bless them, and pray for them
reading.correct: Love them, do good to them, bless them, and pray for them
reading.explain: Jesus tells his listeners to love their enemies, do good to those who hate them, bless those who curse them, and pray for those who mistreat them.

reading.ru: Не судите, и сами не будете судимы.
reading.question: What does Jesus teach about judging others?
options: If you don't judge, you won't be judged
Judging is required by the law
reading.correct: If you don't judge, you won't be judged
reading.explain: Jesus says, “Do not judge, and you will not be judged.”

reading.ru: Что ты смотришь на соринку в глазу своего брата, когда в своем собственном не замечаешь бревна?
reading.question: What does Jesus criticize in the parable about the speck and the log?
options: Noticing a small fault in others while ignoring a greater fault in oneself
Refusing to help a blind friend
Building a house without a foundation
reading.correct: Noticing a small fault in others while ignoring a greater fault in oneself
reading.explain: Jesus asks why someone looks at the speck in a brother's eye while failing to notice the beam in their own eye.

reading.ru: Как только река обрушилась на дом, он тут же рухнул, и падение его было великим.
reading.question: What happened to the house built on the ground without a foundation when the river hit it?
options: It immediately collapsed with a great crash
reading.correct: It immediately collapsed with a great crash
reading.explain: As soon as the river burst against the house built without a foundation, it collapsed at once, and its destruction was great.
